affected_files.role: both `uses: trufflesecurity/trufflehog@main` occurrences (lines 158 and 168: push and PR steps)

analysis.summary: The CI secret-scanning job invokes `trufflesecurity/trufflehog@main` twice — once on push, once on PR — so every workflow run executes mutable third-party code at an unpinned ref. The fix is a one-line-per-site change to a release SHA (with a version comment), satisfying F-CI-002. History shows a prior TruffleHog config fix (103977a) but the @main pin predates and survives it; no commits reference this issue.
analysis.details: This is the smallest change in the P1 wave: no application code, no dependencies, no test impact beyond the suite gate that all five issues share. The only care point is choosing a real current release SHA of trufflesecurity/trufflehog and annotating the pinned version in a comment for future bumps. Fully independent of #15/#16/#17 (different files) and of #19 (different dimension); can land any time and in parallel.
